spans.s: इच्छक [icchaka] इच्छा [icchā], इच्छा See under इष्.
N. of a tree; Shaddock, which is a large species of orange; citrus, Medica (Mar. महाळुंग).
इच्छकः [icchakḥ], N. of a tree, the citron.
इच्छत् [icchat], pres. p. Wishing, desirous, willing; अनिच्छ- न्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः
Wish, desire, inclination of mind, will; इच्छया according to one's desire, at will.

(In gram.) The form of the Desiderative.-Comp. -दानम् fulfilment of a wish. -निवृत्तिः f. suppression of desire, indifference to worldly desires.-फलम् the solution of a question or problem. -रतम् desired sports, favourite pastimes; नीता रात्रिः क्षणमिव मया सार्धमिच्छारतैर्या
The first manifestation of divine power. -वसु a. 'possessing wealth according to wish', epithet of Kubera. -संपद् f. fulfilment of one's wishes.
.] Wishing, desirous; usually in comp. इच्छुः कामयितुं त्वं माम्...
